newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end slightly down in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end slightly down in slow trade.

text.p: Shanghai B shares reversed the morning's gains to end slightly down on Wednesday because shares with heavy index weighting fell from highs even though gainers outnumbered losers, brokers said.
But trading was dull with most investors taking a wait-and-see attitude for a better chance to cash in, they said.
The B index edged down 0.437 points or 0.48 percent to 90.076 points on volume of 14.212 million shares worth $10.988 million, compared with $17.188 million on Tuesday.
"Some shares which institutions paid a lot of attention to have risen too much over the past few days, so that's why there was less follow-up speculative buying today," said one broker.

"The market will linger around current levels in the short term because investors are waiting for Jinan Qingqi Motorcycle to list," another broker said, adding its huge capitalisation could see the company have a major impact on the index.
Jinan Qingqi issued 230 million B shares late last week at $0.482 per share.
The company did not give a timetable for listing but brokers said they expected it soon.
Of 43 B shares, 42 traded, with 13 down, 14 flat and 15 up.
Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass was the biggest loser on poor prospects, slipping $0.040 or 8.16 percent to $0.450 on volume of 110,500 shares.
Pudong real estate Shanghai Jinqiao Export Processing Zone Development was the most actively traded on domestic buying, gaining $0.022 or 2.75 percent to $0.820 on volume of 1.5 million shares.
Shanghai's A share index ended up on active institutional buying in selective stocks, but market risks increased as signs of over-speculation crept in again, brokers said.
The index rose 24.286 points or 1.74 percent to 1,422.074 points on volume of 678.7 million shares worth 10.3 billion yuan.
The SSE30 blue chip index jumped 129.478 points or 3.17 percent to 4,216.062 points.
Shanghai No. 9 Department Store was the biggest gainer on speculative buying which emerged late in the session, surging 0.85 yuan or 10.05 percent to 9.30 yuan on volume of 2.0 million shares.
